tagline: Name a site, say what you want, and get a spreadsheet

examples.prompt: books.toscrape.com — travel books, with the price and whether they are in stock. Then tell me which are running low.
examples.caption: Two boxes. Jev finds the page, picks the columns and fills the sheet

examples.prompt: Read every product in this category and put the name, price, stock count and product code in a spreadsheet. Stop after 40. Then tell me which ones are out of stock.
examples.caption: One call judged all 16 links: the real items at 76-88%, the site menu at 2%

examples.prompt: I have to check these 60 supplier pages every month for their lead times and minimum order. Write me a job I can run again, then run it and tell me what changed.
examples.caption: The job file is the recipe: run it next month and get next month's answer
